what.text: Enobosarm (also called ostarine, GTx-024 or MK-2866) is a nonsteroidal selective androgen receptor modulator (SARM). It binds the androgen receptor. It was designed to act on muscle and bone while having less effect on tissues such as the prostate and hair. It was developed by GTx, Inc., and is now being studied by Veru Inc.

research.text: Enobosarm has been tested in people since the 2000s, mostly by its developers. The trials measured lean body mass, physical function, cancer outcomes and urinary incontinence. No trial tested it as a treatment for low testosterone in men.

research.title: Healthy elderly men and postmenopausal women (Dalton et al.)

facts.v: double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase II trial
120 healthy men over 60 and postmenopausal women
12 weeks
total lean body mass by DXA scan; physical function, weight, insulin resistance, safety

research.found: Lean body mass rose with dose; the 3 mg group differed from placebo. Stair-climb physical function and insulin resistance also differed at 3 mg. Adverse events were similar across groups. The authors worked for GTx, the developer.

src.label: Dalton et al., J Cachexia Sarcopenia Muscle, 2011

research.meta: USA and Argentina · 2013 · Randomized, double-blind Phase II
research.title: Muscle wasting in people with cancer (Dobs et al.)

facts.v: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial (NCT00467844)
159 men over 45 and postmenopausal women with cancer and at least 2% weight loss; 100 had usable body scans
enobosarm 1 mg or 3 mg a day, or placebo
up to 113 days
change in total lean body mass by DXA scan

research.found: Lean body mass rose from baseline in both enobosarm groups (median 1.5 kg and 1.0 kg) and did not change on placebo. The most common serious adverse events were cancer progression, pneumonia and febrile neutropenia, at similar rates in all groups; none were judged drug-related. Funded by GTx.

src.label: Dobs et al., Lancet Oncol, 2013

research.meta: International · 2011 to 2014 · Two randomized, double-blind Phase III trials
research.title: POWER trials in lung cancer (NCT01355484, NCT01355497)

facts.v: two randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase III trials run by GTx
321 and 330 people with non-small cell lung cancer starting platinum chemotherapy
84 days
share of people with stair-climb power up 10% or more, and share with no loss of lean body mass

research.found: In the registry results, more people on enobosarm kept lean body mass in both trials (41.9% vs 30.4%; 46.5% vs 37.9%). For stair-climb power, the share was 29.4% vs 24.2% in one trial and 19.5% vs 24.8% (lower on enobosarm) in the other. Enobosarm was not approved for cancer wasting.

src.label: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01355484
ClinicalTrials.gov NCT01355497

research.title: Advanced ER-positive breast cancer (Palmieri et al., G200802)

facts.v: randomized, open-label, multicentre Phase 2 trial comparing two doses
136 postmenopausal women with previously treated AR-positive, ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer
enobosarm 9 mg or 18 mg a day
clinical benefit at 24 weeks; safety

research.found: At 24 weeks, 32% (9 mg) and 29% (18 mg) of evaluable women had clinical benefit. Grade 3 or 4 drug-related adverse events occurred in 8% and 16%, most often raised liver enzymes, high blood calcium and fatigue. Funded by GTx.

src.label: Palmieri et al., Lancet Oncol, 2024

research.title: Stress urinary incontinence in postmenopausal women (NCT03241342)

facts.v: randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled Phase 2 trial run by GTx
491 postmenopausal women enrolled
12 weeks
number of women with stress incontinence episodes cut by half or more

research.found: In the registry results, 94 of 163 (1 mg), 96 of 163 (3 mg) and 87 of 165 (placebo) women met the 50% reduction goal.

src.label: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03241342

research.title: Older adults starting semaglutide (NCT06282458)

facts.v: randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind dose-finding Phase 2 trial; sponsor Veru Inc.
168 adults aged 60 and over starting semaglutide for weight management
enobosarm 3 mg or 6 mg a day, or placebo, with semaglutide
112 days, then up to day 196 without semaglutide
percent change in total lean body mass at day 112

research.found: The registry lists the trial as completed in August 2025, with no results posted. The search found no peer-reviewed paper reporting it.

src.label: ClinicalTrials.gov NCT06282458

research.title: PLATEAU: enobosarm with semaglutide, adults 65 and over (NCT07446998)

facts.v: randomized, placebo-controlled, triple-masked Phase 2b trial; sponsor Veru Inc.
239 adults aged 65 and over taking semaglutide (Wegovy)
enobosarm 3 mg or placebo, with weekly semaglutide
total body weight at day 476; physical function and safety

research.found: Started March 2026; active, not recruiting. Completion is estimated for December 2027. No results yet.

us.text: Enobosarm is not FDA approved for any use. It is an investigational drug in clinical trials. Products sold as “research use only” are unapproved drugs, and FDA does not allow them to be sold for people to take. As of November 1, 2026.

items.text: FDA says SARMs, which mimic the effects of testosterone and anabolic steroids, are not FDA approved.

items.text: FDA says that although SARMs are often marketed as dietary supplements or “sold for research use only,” they are considered unapproved drugs, and SARMs cannot be legally marketed in the US as a dietary supplement or a drug at this time. FDA also notes that products labelled “for research purposes” or “not for human consumption” have been sold directly to consumers for human use. FDA does not allow these products to be sold for people to take.

after.text: The WADA 2026 Prohibited List names enobosarm (ostarine) under S1.2 Other anabolic agents, in the class of selective androgen receptor modulators (SARMs). S1 substances are prohibited at all times, in and out of competition. The 2027 list keeps the same S1.2 wording.

side.text: In trials, enobosarm’s side effects included raised liver enzymes and high blood calcium. Case reports describe liver injury in people who used products sold as ostarine. FDA warns of serious risks from SARMs.

items.text: in the 120-person elderly trial, adverse events were similar to placebo. In the breast cancer trial, grade 3 or 4 drug-related events occurred in 8% (9 mg) and 16% (18 mg), most often raised liver enzymes, high blood calcium and fatigue.

items.text: FDA lists serious or life-threatening problems linked to SARMs in studies and reports: higher risk of heart attack or stroke, psychosis and hallucinations, sleep problems, sexual dysfunction, liver injury and acute liver failure, infertility, miscarriage and testicular shrinkage. FDA says liver injuries needing hospital care have occurred.

items.text: Health Canada links SARMs to drug-induced liver damage, heart attack and stroke, changes in blood lipids, fluid retention, thicker blood, and hormone disruption that can lead to infertility, lower sex drive, sexual dysfunction and breast enlargement in men.

items.text: SARMs act on the androgen receptor. Like testosterone, they can lower the body’s own testosterone and the hormones that drive sperm production. FDA and Health Canada both list infertility among the risks.
